## Business pains
- Plausible Analytics determined that standard open-source licenses do not provide sufficient protection against external commercial threats. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF94S4aIAjpGNC1PJ0MwVQDHwPT3EhqciYl8S_DHDjFdJyYRvHqkzAx76g-e79gotzuYFxmP0svXiPVVP3wg6A0TxOtL240wiJbY6JfQ9VLocGbbLO7qPnYN-3iuDHsFQVq) (quote: "the AGPL license doesn't go far enough to protect us against all the threats we face.")
- Plausible Analytics encounters high switching costs when attempting to persuade prospective customers to migrate from legacy analytics platforms. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFX49tpy1ISAb4msgKWQlJ8DelkyYNQdRhUWgb1D_f_ac74zLlwix4FjkiHOdSgVb--2iMYc_-Fqq4HNm1KOzd6r1msrHMoLWg6_95OM3On88MRQ5Z9RLb1S_Vr-lxInD3B) (quote: "the cost of switching for an analytics tool is quite high and I've found it very hard to convince someone who isn't already looking")
- Plausible Analytics excludes deep product analytics features such as heatmaps and individual visitor tracking by design. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFnjxcFPB-UTPbGntIV9OHe6iV21G8CXTvjbLxNuVaWcPqX_vBsXCwSiaR99a1qYm-AbDnZuXp_Z7rHTQxAJimt8FkHBFLazruJ94TA6aUsZQdMDRs1qnN4GWpSM02l-BBrKWVt) (quote: "Plausible is likely not a good fit if you: Need session replay, heatmaps or individual visitor recordings; Need user-level product analytics")
- Plausible Analytics cannot rely on traditional paid advertising due to its high cost and conflict with privacy principles. (source: https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHQbkDXXIAEU6i3kUVHYVT_kRHT1KrpmtzPtHRdQ07A6jPpwCY_nswgVDQRcyg2bBXA5mbcCKlXK85kgvIoXpHMDxMBrtz8m9DO6vR7a8qwuODEJhk2jCuUUdjwxktP8tVPqTGsk9jV11LIfys=) (quote: "It's also a very expensive and risky way of doing marketing that few without venture funding can afford in the long run.")
- Hypothesis: Plausible faces the recurring risk of third parties commercializing its open-source codebase without contributing to development or driving cloud subscription revenue. (based on: Plausible Analytics determined that standard open-source licenses do not provide sufficient protection against external commercial threats)
- Hypothesis: High switching friction keeps mainstream website operators tied to Google Analytics unless triggered by specific privacy compliance mandates. (based on: Plausible Analytics encounters high switching costs when attempting to persuade prospective customers to migrate from legacy analytics platforms)
- Hypothesis: Plausible's intentional lack of granular visitor tracking and session replay prevents it from winning product analytics deals in mature digital product teams. (based on: Plausible Analytics excludes deep product analytics features such as heatmaps and individual visitor tracking by design)
- Hypothesis: Avoiding paid performance marketing limits customer acquisition velocity relative to venture-funded alternatives. (based on: Plausible Analytics cannot rely on traditional paid advertising due to its high cost and conflict with privacy principles)
